title: chat-types: decide stringly vocab retype before 0.4
description: Freeze blocker from the third 2026-10-20 freeze review. JMAP-do5p (open, no parent/blocks link to JMAP-lrgt, no 'bd: JMAP-do5p' commit) retypes stringly-typed chat-types vocabulary fields as impl_string_enum! enums. Only item 2 (ChatMember.role -> ChatMemberRole) landed, via JMAP-lrgt.2 fba3c514. Still String at HEAD: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/space.rs:30 SpaceRole.permissions Vec<String>; space_set.rs:162 RolePatch.permissions Option<Vec<String>>; chat.rs:122 ChannelPermission.target_type String; chat.rs:132/138 ChannelPermission.allow/deny Vec<String>; ephemeral.rs:26 ChatStreamEnable.data_types Vec<String>. Changing a pub field's type after 0.4 breaks semver, so either land do5p items 1, 3 and 4 before the freeze, or record a decision to freeze them as String (and close do5p and its duplicate JMAP-pbqe). Then link the outcome to JMAP-lrgt.
